mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as trackCName, con.Con_Name as conName, c2.C_Name as sgName, con.Con_Plan_Start_Date as planStartTime, con.Con_Plan_End_Date as planEndTime, con.Con_Money_Total as conTotalAmount, mn.* from Track_Audit_Month mn left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_ID=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on pro.P_Audit_Unit = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on con.Con_Party_B_Id = c2.C_Id where mn.P_Id = #{pId} and mn.State=7
